content.about: Oman sits on the southeastern corner of the Arabian Peninsula, with a long coast on the Arabian Sea. Rocky mountains, deep canyons and desert dunes cover its land. Oman was a great seafaring nation, trading as far as East Africa. Frankincense, a fragrant resin, has been harvested here for thousands of years.

standout.text: Majlis al Jinn in Oman is one of the largest known cave chambers in the world.

didYouKnow: Oman's southern Dhofar region gets monsoon rain and turns green each summer.
Old falaj water channels still water its farms.
Sea turtles nest on its beaches at Ras al Jinz.
